title: Include current-page group counts in follow-up PDF export
description: A salesperson exporting grouped follow-up reminders as PDF sees selected current-page detail and scoped group counts from the authorized preview. Render status or salesperson labels/counts after detail with page breaks, while groupBy none retains original PDF. Never query unbounded records or include out-of-scope rows; every PDF request rechecks current-user menu/scope through existing endpoint. Missing SimHei remains an explicit error and existing HTTP logging audits export. Development only: no schema or migration changes, production SQL or real database execution, arbitrary SQL, business writes, secrets, deployment or browser acceptance. Verify focused PDF tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Grouped PDF uses only authorized current-page metadata and preserves selected detail columns; none retains detail-only layout.
Group labels/counts remain readable across page breaks; empty pages are explicit, and missing SimHei fails clearly.
PDF tests cover none/status/salesperson groups, empty and multi-page output and font failure; safe Release build/test passes.
